items.title: Write a focused resolution execution plan for the three high gaps
items.context: The existing B-3a80 document is a triage and boundary plan. This story should add a concrete next execution plan for two signed-workspace binding gaps plus the Layer4 customerKeyRef future or blocked gap. It must avoid claiming the gaps are already fixed.
items.userSees: A new decision document explains how to resolve the two signed-workspace gaps and the customerKeyRef future/blocked gap without false closure.

happy.desc: Document names all three current gap_analyze high gaps and assigns each to an exact follow-up action.

edge.desc: Document says customerKeyRef remains future/blocked unless a separate Layer4 implementation story provides redaction and Authority receipt evidence.

adversarial.desc: Document forbids claiming F-009 closure, Layer2/Layer4 unlock, productionDone, receiptVerified, or Authority completion from this planning story.

verificationEvidence.note: The execution plan names all three current high gaps and assigns them to bounded follow-up workstreams.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "future/blocked|Path B1: Keep It Future/Blocked|customerKeyRef remains a future Layer 4 requirement|Forbidden result wording" docs/requirements/decisions/resolve-gap-analyze-three-high-gaps-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: The document preserves customerKeyRef as future/blocked unless a separate Layer4 implementation story is opened.

verificationEvidence.command: lattice gap_analyze | node -e "let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{const json=JSON.parse(s.slice(s.indexOf("{"),s.lastIndexOf("}")+1)); const high=json.gaps.filter(g=>g.severity==="high").length; const medium=json.gaps.filter(g=>g.severity==="medium").length; if(high!==3||medium!==0){console.error(JSON.stringify({high,medium})); process.exit(1)} console.log(JSON.stringify({high,medium,ok:true}))})"
verificationEvidence.note: Mechanical assertion proves the plan did not increase current high or medium gap count; expected state remains exactly 3 high and 0 medium.

items.title: Update requirements navigation for the new execution plan
items.context: If a new decision document is created, NAV must include it and keep the document count consistent.
items.userSees: NAV lists the new three-high-gap resolution plan and the decision document count remains consistent.

happy.desc: NAV includes a relative link to resolve-gap-analyze-three-high-gaps-execution-plan.md.

edge.desc: NAV decision document count matches the number of decision links after the new document is added.

adversarial.desc: NAV does not remove or overwrite the prior B-3a80 triage plan link.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "Resolve gap_analyze Three High Gaps Execution Plan" docs/requirements/NAV.md
verificationEvidence.note: NAV includes the new resolution plan link.

verificationEvidence.command: node -e "const fs=require("fs"),path=require("path"); function walk(d){return fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>{const p=path.join(d,e.name); return e.isDirectory()?walk(p):(p.endsWith(".md")?[p]:[])})} const s=fs.readFileSync("docs/requirements/NAV.md","utf8"); const declared=Number((s.match(/^> (\\d+) 个文件/m)||[])[1]); const actual=walk("docs/requirements").length; if(declared!==actual){console.error(JSON.stringify({declared,actual}));process.exit(1)} console.log(JSON.stringify({declared,actual,ok:true}))"
verificationEvidence.note: NAV declared file count equals the actual markdown file count under docs/requirements.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "F-009 gap_analyze High Gaps Execution Plan|Resolve gap_analyze Three High Gaps Execution Plan" docs/requirements/NAV.md
verificationEvidence.note: NAV keeps the prior B-3a80 triage plan link and adds the new resolution plan link.
